purpose: Assignable research tasks. A task being complete does not change a candidate's scientific status.
claim_policy: Claims are advisory. Record the owner, starting revision, and bounded scope in an issue or handoff; preserve parallel independent work.

tasks.title: Independently audit the published-model reproduction
tasks.first_step: Read the cited Rodal paper and compare its scalar potential, units, and fiducial parameters with the implemented reproduction.
acceptance: Provide an equation-by-equation comparison with exact paper locations and source revision.
Independently reproduce the paper fiducial calculation without importing the main evaluator's Hessian routine.
Explain disagreements, numerical error, and any unsupported interpretation.
scope: No benchmark change without a version proposal

tasks.title: Prove the metric-to-Eulerian-energy bridge
tasks.first_step: State the exact metric, lapse, shift, normal observer, signature, and curvature conventions used by the benchmark.
acceptance: Derive the stated rho_E expression from the metric and chosen Einstein-equation conventions.
Express the result in the formal definitions used by certificate consumers.
Document all assumptions and axiom dependencies; do not assume the target formula as a new axiom.
scope: A complete GR bridge, not only its final algebraic identity

tasks.title: Specify continuous admission conditions for the first stable benchmark
tasks.first_step: Inventory which current constraints are exact decoder restrictions and which properties are only sampled or unimplemented.
acceptance: Specify every promised cabin, regularity, stress, curvature, and causal condition with its domain and units.
Justify the chosen thresholds and identify an admissible baseline or document the obstruction.
Propose an explicit stable benchmark version rather than silently editing existing comparison records.

tasks.title: Construct a rigorous whole-space energy enclosure
tasks.first_step: Separate the finite-domain absolute-value integral and infinite exterior tail, and locate where the current numerical estimate lacks a proved error enclosure.
acceptance: Produce checked lower and upper bounds for the complete E_abs integral.
Handle sign changes, coordinate singularities, integration Jacobians, and all exterior contributions.
Make the certificate checker reject malformed, incomplete, and overoptimistic bounds.
Connect the certificate statement to the continuum integral, with its remaining GR dependency explicit.

tasks.title: Bind exact candidate data to formal definitions
tasks.first_step: Map the rational polynomial coefficient encoding and trusted support function to exact formal objects.
acceptance: Establish that formal and numerical decoders refer to the same candidate and benchmark.
Check coefficient bounds, physical polynomial degree, support matching, and required regularity over the whole domain.
Bind certificate inputs to canonical candidate and benchmark identities without trusting user-provided status flags.

tasks.title: Check stress and curvature through an independent tensor calculation
tasks.first_step: Audit the existing metric-sampling Christoffel/Ricci/Einstein route in src/warpproof/independent.py, then extend the stress and curvature diagnostics in an explicit orthonormal observer frame.
tasks.bootstrap_evidence: The included finite-difference route agrees with the reduced invariant at five nonsymmetric baseline points with approximately second-order refinement. It shares the profile/shift implementation and is a numerical diagnostic, not a formal GR bridge.
acceptance: Compare the energy density with the independent tensor route on the baseline and perturbed candidates.
Measure refinement behavior and explain numerical residuals and units.
Label sampled diagnostics as sampled; identify what further bounds would establish continuous admission.

tasks.title: Search the permitted rational perturbation family
tasks.first_step: Run the documented eight-iteration search, then identify one reproducible strategy for exploring exact allowed coefficients.
acceptance: Output exact candidate data accepted by the approved decoder.
Use the frozen benchmark and independently reevaluate any claimed improvement at tighter numerical settings.
Report the actual search budget, unsuccessful regions, and unresolved numerical uncertainty.
Retain numerical-only status until the complete formal pipeline is available.
scope: No changes to the energy definition or constraints

tasks.title: Validate scientific viewer fields and ray interpretation
tasks.first_step: Trace each displayed field, contour, coordinate label, and ray to its generator and mathematical definition.
acceptance: Document which quantities are sampled, interpolated, analytic, or decorative.
Check frame and unit consistency and preserve common scales in candidate comparisons.
Keep rendering provenance linked to the exact candidate and benchmark.
Ensure imported JSON cannot enable a certified label or hide missing obligations.
scope: No claim that an animation proves causal transport

tasks.title: Complete and independently audit formal promotion
tasks.first_step: Keep the current refusal gate unchanged while defining a complete candidate-admission theorem and evidence manifest.
acceptance: Kernel-check the whole theorem chain for a candidate under the approved stable benchmark.
Independently review the assumptions, axiom closure, input binding, and trusted checker.
Reject invalid proofs, incomplete bounds, mismatched candidates, stale benchmarks, and unsupported status claims.
Regenerate and review evidence from a clean checkout before creating the first certified record.
